claims: TSA wait times often exceed 30 minutes.
Major hubs report delays of over an hour due to staffing shortages, especially during spring break.
The MyTSA app is the official app.
The MyTSA app provides 24/7 nationwide updates on security checkpoints.
TSA PreCheck has an average wait time under 10 minutes.
Some airports advise arriving 4–5 hours early during peak times.
Houston (Hobby/IAH), New Orleans (MSY), ATL, EWR, JFK, MIA, and DEN have longer than average wait times.
